body:
PR845's P112 single-lift obstruction explicitly leaves complex scalar coefficients outside its scope. This research note proves that every complex single lift of any finite real matrix has a real representative with exactly the same reader/source supports in every term. Applied to PR845, this preserves the entire ordered nine-term pairing-rank cost vector and extends its cost floor of 64 to arbitrary complex coefficients and source corrections. No new kappa is claimed.

The proof uses a real-linear projection that avoids finitely many zeros and projects source reciprocals. The hypothesis remains eight retained coordinate readers and one added total, with exact equality on every matrix entry. Changed readers, multiple added totals, masked identities, physical compilation, coefficient-size efficiency, and the inherited all-size/analytic obligations remain outside scope.

Only `research/p112-complex-single-lift/` is added. Exact base: `407d52ff15b2217b6e22bce44728b4c3907b6515`. Ten inherited inputs are pinned by SHA-256 and Git blob; `upstream/` and the selected conditional frontier are unchanged. Attribution remains with Mihir Srivastava (@mihir-s-05) for PR845, DreamingOfClouds for PR717/446, Joel Pulikkan / GamingPuzzled for PR620, and the construction lineage. PR968's adjacent eight-term frame-pair result is credited as related work, not used as a premise.

Reproduce with Python 3.10+ and no third-party packages:

```sh
python -I -S -B research/p112-complex-single-lift/verify.py
```

Expected final marker: `PASS_P112_COMPLEX_SINGLE_LIFT`. This replays both predecessor premise checkers, the new primary certificate and the independent implementation. The latter completes 460 exact Gaussian-rational cases, 4,140 support-pair comparisons, 460 ordered cost vectors and 56 full matrix identities (702,464 entries). Eight primary and six independent controls address actual failure modes. The written proof supplies the arbitrary-complex quantifier; these finite checks are not a formal proof of integer multiplication.

Local validation includes a relocated, optimized Python 3.11 run with site packages disabled, corruption rejection, and the selected-record check. The package records exact scope and validation details; unrelated repository-wide/cold-supplier suites were not rerun and no hosted-CI pass is claimed.

Sprint track: structural decoder research, OS assignment seed 40. The local claim records three candidates, the scoped selection and overlap checks. Prepared for @woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, implementation, delegated AI review and writing. Apache-2.0.
title: Scoped negative result: complex single lifts cannot lower P112 copy cost
